triples.tail_surface: Check the alignment of pump and motor shafts
triples.evidence_text:
Check the alignment of pump and motor shafts and if necessary realign, see
                         paragraph 3.4.3 "Alignment of the coupling".

triples.tail_surface: Place a ruler (A) on the coupling
triples.evidence_text:
Place a ruler (A) on the coupling. Place or remove as many copper shims as is
                         necessary to bring the electric motor to the correct height so that the straight edge
                         touches both coupling halves over the entire length, see figure 4.

triples.tail_surface: Check the alignment once again using a pair of external callipers (B)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用外卡钳再次检查对中
triples.evidence_text:
Check the alignment once again using a pair of external callipers (B) at 2 diametrical
                         opposite points on the sides of the coupling halves, see figure 4.

triples.tail_surface:
place the base plate level on the foundation with
                         the aid of shims
triples.evidence_text:
In case of permanent arrangement place the base plate level on the foundation with
                         the aid of shims.

triples.tail_surface: Place copper shims under the feet of the electric motor
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在电机脚下放置铜垫片
triples.evidence_text:
Place copper shims under the feet of the electric motor. Fix the electric motor to the
                       base plate.
